name: skills-hub
description: Engineering skills that engage on their own when they change the result, and stay quiet when they would not.

plugins.name: skills-hub
plugins.description: Fifteen engineering disciplines: impact mapping, outcome proof, production readiness, investigation, project direction, standards, localization, dependency and API-contract decisions, deployment compatibility, system architecture design, project kickoff, delivery planning with any ticket tracker, release engineering and an observability baseline, plus an opt-in pipeline that runs them in the order you pick and a delivery lead that works through a project's tickets.
